frequency_question: How often does structural friction prevent the successful implementation of a proposed macroprudential capital buffer increase within a designated timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes all formal proposals or discussions regarding the deployment or upward adjustment of the countercyclical capital buffer (CCyB) and major structural capital adequacy rules by the Federal Reserve Board of Governors.

cases.name: Initial Basel III Final Rules Implementation

provenance_note: claimed 2 hits but 3 of 5 cases are marked hit; rate recomputed from the cases
coverage_note: 5 major formal review/action cycles identified since the establishment of the modern CCyB framework.
known_gaps: Excludes informal staff-level friction that never reaches a formal Board vote.
skeleton: Regulatory macroprudential adjustment cycles where systemic risk warnings meet structural inter-agency and institutional inertia.
multiplier: 2 successful implementations / 5 major review and adjustment junctures
validity_reason: The regulatory framework and voting structures of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors remain stable over multi-year horizons barring major legislative overhauls.
